items.title: HomePod Mini 2 first look: Three things I love and one disappointment
items.raw_content: When I first heard about the new $149 HomePod Mini 2 at Apple's Welcome Home event last month, I was disappointed. It's been six years since Apple launched its entry-level smart speaker, and all it got in the second gen was a chip bump, some color glowy stuff, and better AirPlay? For $50 more than […]
items.title_zh: HomePod mini 2 上手：我喜欢的三点和一处遗憾
items.summary: The Verge's first look at the $149 HomePod Mini 2 says the second-generation speaker, launched six years after the original, adds a chip upgrade, new color effects, and improved AirPlay. The reviewer questions whether the changes justify the higher price.

items.title: Apple acquires Ascend․io, an agentic AI engineering startup
items.raw_content: Apple recently struck a deal to acquire Ascend.io, a company focused on agentic data engineering technology. Under the Digital Markets Act, Apple must now publicly report acquisitions above a certain size. This has given us new insight into the company’s acquisition strategy, including glimpses at its future goals . more…
items.title_zh: Apple 收购智能体 AI 工程初创公司 Ascend.io
items.summary: Apple has struck a deal to acquire Ascend.io, a startup focused on agentic data engineering; the purchase became public through acquisition reporting required under the Digital Markets Act.

items.title: Tencent Cloud Launches Data and Training Stack for Robots and Self-Driving, Plans TCLake XPhysis
items.raw_content: Tencent Cloud launched an integrated multimodal data processing and model training stack for embodied AI and autonomous driving, and said it will release a TCLake XPhysis physical AI platform.

items.summary: Tencent Cloud launched an integrated multimodal data processing and model training stack for embodied AI and autonomous driving, and said it will release a TCLake XPhysis physical AI platform.

items.title: A Man from the Future: Why Johnny Can't Stop Abstracting
items.title_zh: 为什么 Johnny 停不下抽象
items.summary: A blog essay asks why engineers keep abstracting, reflecting on how some people find thinking painful while others treat it as a necessity or an addiction.

items.title: Meta Employees Denounce Interference in Brazilian Elections
items.title_zh: Meta 员工谴责干预巴西选举
items.summary: Meta employees publicly criticized company leadership over decisions they say could compromise the credibility of Brazil's democratic process, Panamerican Dispatch reported.

items.title: Anthropic trained Claude on illegally obtained Stanford professors' books
items.title_zh: Anthropic 用盗版斯坦福教授著作训练 Claude
items.summary: The Stanford Daily reports that Anthropic pirated the work of at least 10 Stanford academics to train Claude, in a case tied to a $1.5 billion copyright settlement.

items.title: Apple's git still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates
items.title_zh: 苹果 git 仍信任被攻破的 eMudhra 证书
items.summary: Eleven days after Apple was notified of the eMudhra certificate authority compromise, the git, curl and python3 shipped with macOS still trust the compromised certificates, according to a researcher's writeup.

items.title: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model that you can't use
items.title_zh: Gemini 4 Carbon：你用不上的新前沿模型
items.summary: Ars Technica reports that Gemini 4 Carbon is essentially a slightly better version of Argon, and that the model is not available for general use.

items.title: Apple and OpenAI trade secrets lawsuit now has an official trial date
items.title_zh: 苹果与 OpenAI 商业秘密案确定开庭日期
items.summary: Judge Edward Davila set the schedule and a trial date for Apple's trade-secrets lawsuit against two former employees, OpenAI and io Products.

items.title: Google rolling out software updates for these Nest Cam and Doorbell models
items.title_zh: Google 为多款 Nest Cam 与门铃推送软件更新
items.summary: Google is rolling out software updates to several Nest Cam and Doorbell models, alongside updates for several of its other smart home devices.

items.title: YouTube for Google TV update gives YouTube Music a distracting red logo I can’t stand
items.title_zh: YouTube for Google TV 更新给 YouTube Music 加上扎眼的红色标志
items.summary: YouTube is rolling out, or at least testing, an update for Google TV that makes YouTube Music stand out with a prominent red logo that the author dislikes.

items.title: MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR looks awesome, but I’m not rushing to upgrade
items.title_zh: MacBook Pro 的 PROLED XDR 很惊艳，但我还不急着升级
items.summary: After five years, Apple released its first major MacBook Pro overhaul since the M1 Pro and M1 Max models, but the author finds the design underwhelming and is not rushing to upgrade.

items.title: The FDA wants to pull its approval of a drug. It’s not so easy.
items.title_zh: FDA 想撤回一款药物的批准，却没那么容易
items.summary: The FDA says Tavneos was approved on the basis of manipulated study data and wants to withdraw its approval, but the process is proving difficult.

items.title: Novellas with Groff

items.summary: A blog post explains how to produce novellas with the Groff typesetting system, as shared on Hacker News.

items.summary: 9to5Mac rounds up early Black Friday Apple deals, including discounts on the Apple Watch Ultra 4, M6 Mac mini, and M5 MacBook Air, plus pre-order offers on the M6 MacBook Pro and iMac.

items.title: Fixing Tool-Call Accuracy in vLLM
items.title_zh: 修复 vLLM 的工具调用准确率
items.summary: Ubicloud explains how enabling constrained decoding in vLLM 0.31 brought tool-call schema accuracy to 100% for newer Kimi and DeepSeek models, after it had maintained its own fork.

items.title: Robot electronic-skin startup MoSense raises around RMB 100 million in angel-plus funding
items.title_zh: 机器人电子皮肤公司 MoSense 融资约 1 亿元
items.summary: CDH Investments and Oasis Capital led a roughly RMB 100 million angel-plus round for MoSense, a Shanghai startup building full-body tactile sensing for robots.

items.title: RoboParty Open-Sources Its RP1 Humanoid, From Mechanical Design and Joints to Control Software
items.title_zh: RoboParty 开源 RP1 人形机器人
items.summary: RoboParty open-sourced the RP1, a 135 cm humanoid with 24 or 30 degrees of freedom, releasing mechanical design, joint modules, firmware, robot models and training tools as a full-stack platform.

items.title: OpenAI联合创始人：全球只有5000人站在AI最前沿……
items.title_zh: OpenAI联合创始人：全球只有5000人站在AI最前沿……
items.summary: An OpenAI co-founder argues that only about 5,000 people worldwide are working at the very frontier of AI, according to a Huxiu article.

items.summary: Xpeng launched the MONA L05 on October 29, the first five-seat SUV in its lower-priced MONA lineup, with list prices starting at RMB 144,800 and electric variants offering up to 635 km of CLTC range.

items.title: InSpatio Opens a Simulation-First Robot Data Center in Hangzhou, Targets a Million Hours a Month
items.title_zh: InSpatio 在杭州开设仿真优先的机器人数据中心，目标每月百万小时
items.summary: Spatial intelligence firm InSpatio opened what it calls China's first simulation-led embodied AI data center in Hangzhou, aiming to produce a million hours of robot training data per month.

items.title: Huawei Qiankun ADS Passes 17.3 Billion Kilometers of Cumulative Assisted Driving
items.title_zh: 华为乾崑 ADS 累计辅助驾驶里程突破 173 亿公里
items.summary: Huawei's Qiankun ADS has logged more than 17.3 billion kilometers of assisted driving and avoided over 6.91 million potential collisions, about 1.3 billion kilometers more than in early October.

items.title: 韩国年轻人，其实比日本人更想结婚
items.title_zh: 韩国年轻人，其实比日本人更想结婚
items.summary: A Huxiu article says young South Koreans are actually more eager to marry than young Japanese.

items.title_zh: 让 Claude 构建电影级落地页的技能
items.summary: A free Claude skill from MotionSites that prompts Claude to build cinematic, award-level landing pages.

items.summary: Capri is an Edgerunners-inspired desktop AI agent that works with Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and other coding tools.

items.summary: Tongjiang Lab offers free interactive 3D science lessons for high school students.

items.title_zh: OpenBot：本地优先的 AI 队友工作区
items.summary: OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates, letting Codex, Claude and Grok run in dedicated workspaces with task queues, file sharing, browser control and agent-to-agent collaboration.

items.title_zh: CelestialStarfish/Ads-Blocker：桌面广告拦截安装包
items.summary: Ads-Blocker is a GitHub project that its listing describes as a full working installer with complete ad-blocking capabilities, ready to run on desktop.

items.title: arpanjot-coding/AVault
items.title_zh: AVault：无需 Root 的 Android 通话录音与加密音频库
items.summary: AVault is a Kotlin call recorder for Android 12-16+ that uses Shizuku for rootless recording and stores audio in a privacy-first, hardware-encrypted vault with AES-256-GCM, biometrics and auto-cleanup.

items.title: Gezine/CivSwitch
items.title_zh: Gezine/CivSwitch（Switch 用户态代码执行）
items.summary: A GitHub project demonstrates userland code execution on the Nintendo Switch through a Civilization 7 game cartridge, written in JavaScript.

items.title: dankumarlab2090u1/minecraft-hack-menu-2026
items.title_zh: dankumarlab2090u1/minecraft-hack-menu-2026（我的世界作弊菜单）
items.summary: A GitHub repository advertises a Minecraft hack menu for version 1.21.4 Fabric with KillAura, ESP, XRay, Flight, Scaffold, Crystal Aura, and more than 150 modules.

items.title: Function-Space Temporal Self-Distillation for Policy Optimization
items.title_zh: 函数空间策略优化 FSPO
items.summary: FSPO is a single-policy RL framework for reasoning models that keeps sparse past next-token distributions as fixed targets over time, avoiding a persistent teacher while adding privileged disagreement correction.

items.title: Trajectory2Gym: Decision-Grounded Compositional Interaction Synthesis for Tool-Use Agents
items.title_zh: Trajectory2Gym：工具调用轨迹合成
items.summary: Trajectory2Gym builds executable tool-use interactions that target under-supported compositional structures, then supervises only actions justified by what the learner could see at decision time.

items.title: Context as Infrastructure: Knowledge Compilation for Retrieval in Agentic Systems with Harnesses
items.title_zh: 上下文即基础设施：智能体系统中面向检索的知识编译与 Harness
items.summary: The paper argues that agentic retrieval harnesses largely solve accuracy, and that the missing layer is knowledge compilation: an ingestion pipeline in which LLMs enrich documents with navigation hierarchies, entity graphs, timelines, wikis, and memory. It reports that a navigation tree of claim-evidence leaves cut query tokens by 91% when evidence sufficed and 38% on average, and describes RAGFlow's open-source pipeline.

items.title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
items.title_zh: DirCast：电竞赛事直播导演与解说
items.summary: DirCast is a single streaming video-language model that directs and commentates live esports from raw player cameras, deciding when to cut and reading the chosen view at high resolution; it was built on 27 professional Dota 2 matches.

items.title: Clearing the FoG: Training KG Agents to Retrieve the Evidence Behind Their Answers
items.title_zh: FoG：让知识图谱智能体检索证据
items.summary: FoG trains knowledge-graph agents to retrieve the supporting triples behind their answers, combining evidence-grounded synthesis, a KG interaction agent and an evidence-coverage reward.

items.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
items.title_zh: ThinkWorld：以世界想象强化动作推理
items.summary: ThinkWorld learns robot action reasoning as a Chain-of-Dynamics - discrete motion tokens connecting current and future world states - and strengthens it with reinforcement learning over imagined world rollouts, drawing on human video.

items.title: Rollback: Experience Backtracking in World Models for Policy Improvement
items.title_zh: Rollback：在世界模型中回滚经验
items.summary: Rollback turns action-conditioned world models into counterfactual engines that rewind to critical decision points, branch into alternative actions and distill the outcomes into action-level supervision for robot policies.

items.title: TinyAstral: Transferring Self-Evolving Harnesses to Tiny Generalist Manipulation Agents
items.title_zh: TinyAstral：将自进化 Harness 迁移到小型通用操作智能体
items.summary: TinyAstral improves a frozen teacher's harness through recursive self-improvement, then distills a 4B student that replaces the teacher in the same harness. On RoboTwin, harness evolution raised teacher success from 33.4% to 63.6% and the student reached 62.8%, while using about one-fifth of the teacher's accelerator time in deployment.
